title: The evolution of OGraf
summary: Jenny Priestley interviews Niels Borg (TV 2 Danmark), who chairs the EBU OGraf initiative: from its IBC Accelerator origins to TV 2's election touchscreen and telestration. TV 2 Danmark, YLE and SVT are named as broadcasters using OGraf in live production.

title: Working group merges a round of spec corrections
summary: No new features, but clearer rules: stepCount -1 never triggers the end condition, playAction may omit currentStep once the graphic has ended, custom actions are documented as the array the schema always required, and a server MAY validate data against the manifest schema. Still open: HDR colour space (#98), uploading packages over the Server API (#100) and exposing package contents (#90).

title: DaVinci Resolve 21.1.2: faster OGraf playback, and OGraf on Linux
summary: Up to 4x faster OGraf playback on the edit and Fusion pages, select and multi-select template controls, responsive templates that follow the timeline aspect ratio, and OGraf and Lottie on Linux. OGraf clips also use the manifest's action durations to place the stop action.

title: Pixotope 26.3 ships OGraf playout and control
summary: VideoIO renders OGraf and Live Controller drives it: import templates from a folder, a zip or an OGraf server, fill them in the same auto form as Pixotope's own templates, and use Continue, Delta step and Goto step on air. OGraf rendering is in the free Discovery tier too.

title: Matrox shows OGraf in ORIGIN at IBC, with NVIDIA Holoscan for Media
summary: Matrox Video's software-defined production demo lists OGraf graphics among the ORIGIN services connected over MXL. A day later Matrox asked for ORIGIN to be listed as an OGraf renderer, and it now appears on the official site as Matrox Video.

title: OGraf Studio wins TVBEurope Best of Show at IBC 2026
summary: Zero Density's open-source OGraf editor is on TVBEurope's list of Best of Show winners, five days after launch.

title: Fonn Group buys everviz and relaunches it as Teikna
summary: Fonn Group took the remaining everviz shares and is turning it into Teikna, a graphics platform tied into its Saga newsroom system and Mimir. The release does not mention OGraf, but everviz was an early OGraf exporter, and the official OGraf site now lists the vendor as Teikna.

title: Zero Density launches OGraf Studio, an open-source OGraf editor
summary: A browser-based authoring suite with a WYSIWYG canvas, animation tracks, data binding, manifest validation and an optional local MCP server for AI-assisted authoring. Source on GitHub; shown at IBC 2026 and NAB Show New York.

title: OGraf Server API v1 published — the spec is complete
summary: The second half of OGraf v1 is out. With the Server API published, a controller can drive any compliant renderer over a defined interface — the Graphics spec said what a graphic is, this says how to play it. Both halves are now marked stable and production ready, with future changes backwards-compatible or optional.

title: BBright adds EBU OGraf support to its UHD and ST 2110 playout platform
summary: A new graphics engine renders animated OGraf templates directly inside BBright's software playout, covering Ultra HD and SMPTE ST 2110 including ST 2110-41 metadata and 2110-43 timed text. OGraf reaching the playout tier, not just the graphics tier.

title: DaVinci Resolve 21 ships with native OGraf support
summary: The final Resolve 21 release brings OGraf HTML graphics to the Cut, Edit and Fusion pages. The first NLE with native OGraf, and the reason the spec's non-real-time half suddenly mattered.

title: Maps Without Borders: Everviz joins the OGraf revolution
summary: Everviz adds native OGraf export to their interactive maps and dynamic charts. Create a map once, play it on any OGraf-compliant renderer — SPX, Erizos, and beyond.

title: From HTML Graphics to Agile Storytelling
summary: Takeaways from MediaTech Festival 2026. Media Tailor frames OGraf as the industry's open answer to decades of vendor lock-in and details their investment in SPX Graphics to accelerate Nordic adoption.

title: The rise, fall and rise again of open-source solutions in broadcasting
summary: Frans de Jong on how open source came back around in broadcast, with OGraf cited as a project that started the moment its specification existed — a counterpoint to the 'code before spec' pattern he sees emerging elsewhere.

title: Maps at Newsroom Speed at NAB 2026
summary: Everviz previews their NAB 2026 demos — interactive maps built for newsroom turnaround, exported via OGraf for any compliant renderer.

title: coralbay.tv to showcase many new features at NAB 2026
summary: coralbay.tv details their NAB 2026 line-up, including Loopic + EBU OGraf integration in their coralPlay automation workflow.

title: Loopic + coralPlay Integration
summary: Step-by-step on a practical OGraf workflow: graphics designed in Loopic, automated via coralbay's coralPlay. Create once, deploy everywhere in action.

title: Loopic at IBC 2025
summary: Loopic's IBC 2025 recap — showcasing one-click OGraf export and demos running across multiple compliant renderers.

title: EBU launches new HTML graphics standard
summary: Industry coverage of the OGraf launch: an open, web-native graphics standard backed by the EBU, positioned to end vendor lock-in across broadcast workflows.

title: Loopic 2.2.1 now supports OGraf
summary: Loopic ships its first OGraf-compatible release — the no-code HTML graphics editor can now export OGraf packages directly.

title: OGraf, the new HTML graphics standard, is here
summary: SPX's explainer following the EBU webinar: what OGraf solves for operators, how SPX is implementing it, and what it means for existing HTML-graphics workflows.

title: Finnish tech companies partner on EBU's OGraf graphics standard
summary: Coverage of the Media Tailor + SPX Graphics partnership, framing how Nordic players are stepping up to drive OGraf adoption.

title: Create Once, Deploy Everywhere — the EBU's Open Graphics Standard Explained
summary: A clear vendor-neutral explainer: what OGraf is, why it matters, and how it changes the economics of broadcast graphics for smaller broadcasters.

title: OGraf: the EBU's open spec for cross-platform graphics integration
summary: The official EBU overview — the best short, authoritative introduction to OGraf, its scope, and its goals.

title: EBU launches OGraf project to define open graphics specifications
summary: Early industry coverage of the OGraf launch — what EBU set out to build and who was involved from day one.
